t: BFF SEO dot BOT is Born
s: This article introduces BFFSEO.BOT, an experiment in web improvement and AI-SEO. It focuses on self-improving content strategies, optimizing headlines and meta descriptions, and structuring sites for better bot readability, advocating for genuine web improvement over spam.
sub: Headline hierarchy and optimization for bots
Site structure and link hierarchy for crawlers
The future of SEO as generic site hygiene
